pages.title: Programmable Matter
pages.text: Matter that changes its own shape and properties on command. Nanites rearrange its structure, metamaterial tunes its response, and a qubit holds the instructions. Squeeze it and it becomes harder; ask it politely and it becomes a key.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A Nanite Swarm in Nanite Slurry, with a Metamaterial Sheet and a Qubit in the Nanite Assembler, settled into a single shapeable mass. I told it to be a cup and it became one, then a sphere, then a spanner.
